verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I want to stand in Your counsel
Sit at Your table
And speak to You face to face as a friend
I want to stand in Your fire
Wherever Your eyes fall
May You find me faithful to Your heart

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Let me be found with a heart after You
May Your eyes find this heart loyal to You
(Faithful and true)

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
May You be all that's on my mind
All of the time
Let my heart be torn in two
Until Your will is mine

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
Dearly Beloved of my soul, of my soul
Dearly Beloved of my soul, of my soul

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
May Your eyes find this heart longing for You
(Longing for You)
